morphology.pattern_note: 作为不可拆分的外来专名记忆，不分析为马来语词根与词缀的组合；没有可据此列出的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 里德：人名或姓氏；在马来西亚历史语境中，常见于以威廉·里德勋爵命名的里德委员会。
senses.en_definition: Reid, a personal name or surname; in Malaysian historical contexts, especially the name associated with the Reid Commission.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang; dalam konteks sejarah negara, nama keluarga Lord William Reid yang mempengerusikan Suruhanjaya Reid.
senses.nuances: 专有名词，不等同于 suruhanjaya“委员会”。本义项依据可核实的马来西亚历史用法选定；仅凭输入包不能确定原始语料中的具体人物。[马来西亚国家档案局：里德委员会](https://pustakailmu.arkib.gov.my/index.php/ms/pustaka-ilmu/jendela-sejarah/suruhanjaya-perlembagaan-reid)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan ini membincangkan peranan Suruhanjaya Reid dalam penggubalan Perlembagaan Persekutuan Tanah Melayu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本报告讨论里德委员会在制定《马来亚联合邦宪法》过程中的作用。
dual_scenarios.en: This report discusses the Reid Commission's role in drafting the Constitution of the Federation of Malaya.

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian historical writing, Reid is familiar through the commission chaired by Lord William Reid. Established in 1956, the commission prepared constitutional recommendations before Malaya's independence. Its name therefore appears in lessons about nationhood and constitutional government. This explains its local historical prominence, rather than establishing Reid as an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. [National Archives of Malaysia](https://pustakailmu.arkib.gov.my/index.php/ms/pustaka-ilmu/jendela-sejarah/suruhanjaya-perlembagaan-reid)
